name: Technical University of Munich
description: The Technical University of Munich is a public technical university in Munich, founded in 1868. It covers engineering, natural sciences, life sciences, medicine and management.
whyIncluded: TUM has run TUM Asia, its Singapore campus, since 2002 (over 3,000 graduates), it offers English-taught master's programmes in Munich, and Germany is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 640 in UNESCO UIS data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: TUM Graduate School 'Cost of Living in Munich' (status October 2024), one-person household minimums: rent for shared living or studio incl. utilities at least EUR 800 (800-1,200); food at least EUR 300; local public transit EUR 29 (student ticket; 49 for the regular Deutschlandticket); personal = telecommunication/phone/internet/broadcasting fee EUR 50-60 (lower bound used). Health insurance (90-150) excluded. TUM's overall estimate: at least EUR 1,300 a month.

programmes.name: Informatics B.Sc.
programmes.notes: TUM charges non-EU/EEA students who enrolled from winter semester 2024/25 a programme-specific tuition fee; this programme is EUR 3,000 per semester (x2). Compulsory fees = Studierendenwerk basic fee (Semesterbeitrag) EUR 97.00 per semester x2 (no semester ticket; Munich campuses). Fee is fixed for the cohort for the standard period of study plus one semester (TUM fee statute, 12 Feb 2024). Language of instruction: German. 2024 history: fee class in the statute annex (winter 2024/25 introduction) plus the EUR 85 basic fee then in force. No separate 2025 publication was found, so no 2025 entry.
